_about: UNIRA v79 housing allocation simulation parameters. Every value has a 'source' note. SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION = chosen by the modeller, not taken from evidence.csv. Units: km, years, homes, households.

cohort_first_year.source: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION: cohorts arriving in years 5..24 are measured so each has a full 5-year window and the queue is past start-up

seeds_sensitivity.source: Fixed seeds (fewer, to keep runtime < 60 s)

zones.source: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION: stylised coastal city. Coordinates in km. Only desirable zones are rationed; non-desirable zones are assumed to have spare fixed-price homes (UNIRA guarantees a home), so they are each household's fallback.

candidates_per_year.source: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION: households (re)locating each year; ~60% find a desirable zone better than their fallback and apply. Gives ~2.5 applicants per desirable vacancy, inside the 1.0-4.8 range of HDB application rates (evidence.csv singapore_hdb_oversubscription).

initial_backlog_years.source: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION: queue starts with 2 years of applicants already waiting

turnover_rate.source: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION: 5%/yr of occupied desirable homes released (moves, deaths, inherited homes returned to the regional pool under Art. 18.4)

dropout_rate.source: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION: 10%/yr of waiting applicants stop waiting and stay in their fallback home

commute_cost_per_km.source: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION: utility lost per km of home-work distance

household.source: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION: shares are round, plausible European values, not calibrated to a specific census

disability_prob.source: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION; mildly higher in low deciles via disability_income_tilt

disability_income_tilt.source: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION: P(disability) scaled by 1 + tilt*(5.5-decile)/4.5, i.e. x1.5 in D1, x0.5 in D10

care_prob.source: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION: caring for a dependent relative

roots_prob.source: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION: >= 5 years residence / family in the region

income_sigma.source: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION: log-income spread used only for the market benchmark and for labelling deciles

points.source: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION for weights. Categories follow the approved UNIRA design and real precedents: HDB family / proximity (<=4 km) schemes, Vienna residence bonus, Amsterdam waiting + situation points (evidence.csv).

bid_noise_sd.source: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION: bid = income * desirability taste * lognormal noise

speculator_bid_multiplier.source: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION: investors bid above their income share

initial_empty_share.source: Bounded by evidence: Paris vacancy 8.5% (search snippet) and 19% of Paris dwellings not a main residence (Apur 2020). 10% chosen inside that range.

speculator_share_of_applicants.source: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION: owners of one home seeking a desirable second home they will mostly leave empty (Art. 18.2 allows two homes)

empty_release_rate.source: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION: an empty-held home is given back or sold 3%/yr without a rule

rule_deterrence.source: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION: under must-live-in rule 80% of would-be speculators do not apply

rule_detection_rate.source: Evidence-anchored: Vancouver, 49% of properties vacant in 2020 were occupied in 2021 under the tax (evidence.csv). Used as yearly probability an empty desirable home is detected and returned to the pool.

rates.source: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION: share of applicants falsely claiming a care duty (+care points)

audit_probs.source: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION: probability a successful claim is audited before the keys are handed over

income_gradient.source: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION: P(cheat) scaled by 1 + g*(decile-5.5)/4.5, i.e. better-off households game more

ban_years.source: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION: caught cheaters lose the offer and are barred for 5 years

open_lottery_share.source: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION inspired by HDB quotas (evidence.csv: priority schemes reserve up to 30-40% of supply; the rest is balloted): in method points_lottery_open, 30% of each year's desirable vacancies go to an open lottery among all applicants, so low-need households keep a real chance.

build_more_pct.source: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION: extra desirable-zone homes added linearly over 30 years (Art. 18 amendment point 3)

spread_jobs_share.source: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION: 30% of centre jobs moved to non-desirable zones (job decentralisation)
